brls:Label.text: If there ever is a mod that you want to delete permanently, make sure that mod is NOT active in Simple Mod Alchemist first. If it is active, change the mod so it's not. This will make sure all files for that mod are returned to their original locations within the mod's folder under `mod_alchemy`.

Only once the mod is NOT in use, it can be removed as easy as deleting the `mod_alchemy/[-GAME-NAME-] ([-TITLE-ID-])/[-GROUP-]/[-THING-BEING-MODDED-]/[-MOD-NAME-]` folder belonging to it from your SD card.

This is necessary because when a mod is currently being used, its files are currently mixed in with all the other enabled mod files within the '/atmosphere/contents/[-TITLE-ID-]/' folder. When the mod is changed to something else, the app will move the mod's files back to the original folder they were in: 'mod_alchemy/[-GAME-NAME-] ([-TITLE-ID-])/[-GROUP-]/[-THING-BEING-MODDED-]/[-MOD-NAME-]`. Then when you delete that folder, you can be sure all files for that mod are being deleted as well.
You can have the app pick modes for you at random. Mods can be randomly changed individually, by group, or by an entire game. To do so, highlight a game, group or individual mod and press 'X'.
When pressing 'Y' on a mod, you can also adjust the odds that the app may pick each mod.
